The Moonen yacht Sofia, measuring 41.78 meters, was completed in 2013 and remains the largest yacht built by the shipyard. It was originally commissioned for Moonen's former Mexican owner. However, in November 2022, the yacht was sold in a private transaction to its new owner. During this deal, Rob Newton from IYC represented the seller, while the buyer was represented by Yannis Stratis from the Greek brokerage Yacht Broker House (YBH). The yacht's name was changed to Serenity after the sale, and it is currently based in Greece.

The new owning company of the yacht is Australian, and according to the Australian company register ASIC, it is ultimately owned by Geoffrey and Dianne Ford from Sydney. Interestingly, the next generation of the Ford family is also involved in operating the yacht, with their son George Ford (born 1986) serving as one of the Directors of the owning company.

Prior to Serenity, the Fords owned a Darwin 92 model yacht from Cantiere delle Marche, which was built in 2013. However, they later sold this yacht, and it is now known as 3D.

The Fords amassed their wealth through their real estate company, Ford Land Company.

As of 29 June 2023, Serenity was moored in Marina Flisvos in Athens.
